info.shortName: Global X S&P 500 Risk Managed I
info.longName: Global X S&P 500 Risk Managed Income ETF

funds_data.description: The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets in the securities of the Cboe S&P 500 Risk Managed Income Index ("underlying index"). The underlying index measures the performance of a risk managed income strategy that holds the underlying stocks of the S&P 500® Index and applies an options collar strategy (i.e., a mix of short (sold) call options and long (purchased) put options) on the S&P 500® Index.
